themes.name: Digital City Access
themes.rule: Proposals to deliver, access, coordinate, or make transparent municipal information and services through digital tools, connectivity, or service-request channels.

themes.name: Public Safety Response
themes.rule: Proposals to prevent crime, improve perceived safety, or speed emergency response through policing, surveillance, lighting, or emergency facilities.

themes.name: Transit and Street Mobility
themes.rule: Proposals to improve public transit, cycling, or pedestrian and traffic safety through routes, fares, service frequency, rider information, or street design.

themes.name: Affordable Housing
themes.rule: Proposals to increase housing affordability, supply, quality, or rental-market transparency and protections.

themes.name: Health and Care Access
themes.rule: Proposals to expand preventive, primary, specialist, mental-health, or in-home care services.

themes.name: Schools and Student Support
themes.rule: Proposals focused on school facilities, teachers, class conditions, student meals, tutoring, or children's educational instruction.

themes.name: Environmental Sustainability
themes.rule: Proposals to monitor or reduce pollution and resource use through environmental measurement, recycling, composting, renewable energy, or waste-reduction rules.

themes.name: Parks and Outdoor Amenities
themes.rule: Proposals to create or improve greenery, gardens, parks, playgrounds, and other outdoor recreational spaces or facilities.

themes.name: Arts and Civic Culture
themes.rule: Proposals to expand cultural institutions, public art, performances, festivals, or access to museums and libraries.

themes.name: Local Jobs and Business
themes.rule: Proposals to support workers, job training, local hiring, small businesses, coworking, or business licensing.
